create_model_load_llama: load the Llama 3.1 8B model and tokenizer from Hugging Face transformers
build_qlora_config: build a QLoRA configuration with 4-bit quantization and LoRA adapters for causal language modeling
create_training_args: create training arguments specifying output directory, epochs, batch size, and logging settings
create_dataset_imdb: load the IMDB dataset from Hugging Face datasets for supervised fine-tuning
run_sft_trainer: run supervised fine-tuning on the Llama model using the SFTTrainer with LoRA configuration
